welsh.alt: Pastel-painted houses, sandy beaches, and small boats around Tenby harbour in Wales.
welsh.caption: Tenby harbour, viewed from The Croft and Norton, Pembrokeshire, Wales.

manx.alt: Stone walls of Peel Castle beside blue water and the coastal town on the Isle of Man.
manx.caption: Peel Castle on St Patrick’s Isle, Isle of Man.

scottish-gaelic.alt: Turquoise sea and pale sand beneath a wide blue sky at Luskentyre on Harris.
scottish-gaelic.caption: Luskentyre beach on the Isle of Harris, Outer Hebrides, Scotland.

irish.alt: A narrow stone path curves down green cliffs toward the sea at Dunquin Pier.
irish.caption: Cé Dhún Chaoin (Dunquin Pier), Dingle Peninsula, County Kerry, Ireland.

catalan.alt: Colourful riverside houses reflected in the Onyar beneath a clear blue sky in Girona.
catalan.caption: Houses along the River Onyar, Girona, Catalonia. Catalan-speaking communities also live beyond this part of its linguistic territory.
catalan.credit: Richard Mortel from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

taiwanese-taigi.alt: Lanterns and warm shop lights along Shennong Street after dark in Tainan.
taiwanese-taigi.caption: Shennong Street at night in Tainan, Taiwan.

hakka-sixian.alt: A red-roofed pavilion reflected in Meinong Lake with green mountains in the distance.
hakka-sixian.caption: Meinong Lake in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. A view of place, not a representation of every Sixian-speaking community.

hakka-hailu.alt: Colourful tiled roofs and stone lions at the entrance to Citian Temple in Beipu.
hakka-hailu.caption: Citian Temple in Beipu, Hsinchu County, Taiwan.

sorani-kurdish.alt: Turquoise water of Lake Dukan bordered by hills and sunlit greenery in Iraqi Kurdistan.
sorani-kurdish.caption: Lake Dukan, Sulaymaniyah Governorate, Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Sorani’s regional story also extends into Iran.

wenzhounese.alt: Golden walls and ornate tiled roofs of Jiangxin Temple framed by trees in Wenzhou.
wenzhounese.caption: Jiangxin Temple on Jiangxin Island, Wenzhou, Zhejiang, China.

hawaiian.alt: Hanalei Pier, blue ocean, and the mountain ridges beyond Hanalei Bay on Kauaʻi.
hawaiian.caption: Hanalei Bay and pier, Kauaʻi. One view of Hawaiʻi, whose language communities span islands and generations.
